text:
Situation: Ampicillin sodium is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Sandoz Inc. posted a private‑label discontinuation on 2025-12-08, but the drug remains off the overall shortage list. Current inventory across Corvale East and Corvale General ranges from 12.6 to 27.6 days of supply depending on presentation and site.

Why (FDA record): The label for NDC 83270031110 identifies the manufacturing plant as ONESOURCE SPECIALTY PHARMA LIMITED - Beta Lactam Division (FEI 3005652193) in India. FDA inspection 940034 at that FEI ended 2015-09-01 and was classified OAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2015-11-30. A later inspection 1079813 ended 2019-02-14 and was classified VAI, known to FDA on 2019-05-15.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. No shortage exists per FDA records. The Sandoz discontinuation affects only a private‑label product and does not trigger a national shortage designation.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard purchasing from current contracted suppliers; buyer approves.
2. Qualify Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. as a backup source; buyer and P&T committee approve.
3. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly for any status change; buyer approves.
4. Report inventory levels to P&T committee monthly; buyer approves.

Not recommended: Do not initiate emergency allocations, therapeutic substitutions, or rationing at this time.
